records.name: Whitney Yamamura
records.notes: Began as Chancellor of Coast CCD in September 2022. Previously served as the third president of Folsom Lake College (2017-2022) and held multiple academic/administrative roles within the Los Rios CCD dating back to 1989, including interim college presidencies. The district's own chancellor page and Wikipedia article do not name a predecessor chancellor; that gap could not be closed this session.

records.name: Sean C. Hancock
records.notes: Named Interim Chancellor in 2026 after Steven Bloomberg's departure (per Wikipedia, a chancellor resigned in May 2026 prompting the board to seek a new permanent chancellor). Hancock previously served as President of Cerro Coso Community College and has 25+ years in California community colleges.

records.name: Steven Bloomberg
records.notes: Per KCCD's own Chancellor History page. Left the chancellorship in 2026 (resigned per Wikipedia), prompting Sean Hancock's interim appointment.

records.name: Sonya Christian
records.notes: Per KCCD's own Chancellor History page. Left KCCD to become Chancellor of the California Community Colleges system.

records.name: Tom Burke
records.notes: Per KCCD's own Chancellor History page; also served a separate stint as Interim Chancellor 2023-2024 between Christian and Bloomberg.

seats.university: North Orange County Community College District

records.name: Byron D. Clift Breland
records.priorTitle: Chancellor, San Jose-Evergreen Community College District
records.notes: NOCCCD's own bio page states he previously served as "the first African-American Chancellor" of SJECCD for four years, and before that as President of San Jose City College. Exact NOCCCD start year (approx. 2019, inferred from the ~4-year SJECCD tenure ending around when Beatriz Chaidez became interim SJECCD chancellor) and any predecessor chancellor at NOCCCD could not be confirmed from district sources or Wikipedia this session; flagged for further verification.

records.name: Rick MacLennan
records.priorTitle: Educational leadership roles at community colleges in Idaho, Maryland, and Washington
records.notes: Selected by the VCCCD Board of Trustees to serve as Chancellor beginning July 2022; 30+ years of educational leadership experience. VCCCD's own site and Wikipedia do not name a predecessor chancellor; that gap could not be closed this session.

seats.university: South Orange County Community College District

records.name: Julianna M. Asperin Barnes
records.notes: Selected by the Board of Trustees on May 26, 2022; began as Chancellor August 1, 2022. Previously President of Cuyamaca College (2015-2022). Named among Diverse magazine's "Top 25 Women Making a Difference in Higher Academe" (2023). SOCCCD's site does not name her predecessor as chancellor; that gap could not be closed this session.

records.name: Mojdeh Mehdizadeh
records.priorTitle: Interim Chancellor / Executive Vice Chancellor for Education and Technology; President, Contra Costa College
records.notes: The 10th Chancellor of Contra Costa CCD per the district's own District Leadership History chart. Served as Interim Chancellor 2022-2023 before being named permanent Chancellor in 2024; previously Executive Vice Chancellor for Education and Technology and President of Contra Costa College (2015-2018 per the same chart).

records.name: Bryan Reece
records.notes: Per the district's official District Leadership History chart (4cd.edu).

records.name: Eugene Huff
records.notes: Brief interim chancellor in 2020 per the district's official leadership history chart, bridging between Fred E. Wood and Bryan Reece.

records.name: Fred E. Wood
records.notes: Per the district's official District Leadership History chart; succeeded longtime chancellor Helen Benjamin (2005-2016).

records.name: Lee D. Lambert
records.notes: Officially welcomed as Chancellor of Foothill-De Anza CCD on July 31, 2023, coming from the chancellorship of Pima Community College in Tucson, Arizona. FHDA's site does not name his immediate predecessor on this page (widely reported elsewhere to be Judy C. Miner, who served for roughly a decade); that predecessor tenure could not be independently confirmed via primary sources this session.

records.name: Tammeil Gilkerson
records.notes: Selected October 2023, began as Chancellor January 4, 2024. Previously President of Evergreen Valley College (2020-2024) and, before that, President of Laney College (2017-2020) - a Peralta college - making her return to the district "a homecoming."

records.name: Jannett Jackson
records.notes: Per Wikipedia's chancellor list for Peralta CCD.

records.name: Carla Walter
records.notes: Per Wikipedia's chancellor list for Peralta CCD.

records.name: Regina Stanback Stroud
records.notes: Per Wikipedia's chancellor list for Peralta CCD; a rapid series of interim/short-tenure chancellors followed the 2015-2019 tenure of Jowel C. Laguerre.

seats.university: San Mateo County Community College District

records.name: Melissa Moreno
records.priorInstitution: San Mateo County Community College District
records.notes: Served as Interim Chancellor starting 2023, named permanent Chancellor in 2024, per Wikipedia's chancellor history table (cross-checked with the district's own chancellor's-office page identifying her as current chancellor).

records.name: Michael Claire
records.priorInstitution: San Mateo County Community College District
records.notes: Served as interim chancellor before permanent appointment in 2020; retired in 2023. Per Wikipedia's chancellor history table.

records.name: Ron Galatolo
records.notes: Resigned amid a corruption investigation; later fired in 2021 after failing to disclose gifts from vendors, per Wikipedia.

records.name: Earl "Joe" Johnson
records.notes: Resigned to take a position at Clackamas Community College, per Wikipedia.

records.name: Lynn Ceresino Neault
records.notes: Confirmed as current Chancellor of Grossmont-Cuyamaca CCD via the district's own "About the District" leadership listing and Wikipedia infobox. Her exact start year, prior title/institution, and any predecessor chancellor could not be confirmed this session - the district's dedicated chancellor bio pages returned 404s and search engines were unavailable; further verification recommended.

records.name: Lena Tran
records.notes: Named Interim Chancellor of YCCD in 2025 (press release 25-02); previously President of Columbia College (named to that role in 2022) and earlier Dean of Business and Workforce Development / VP of Strategic Partnerships at Evergreen Valley College and San Jose City College. As of this research, YCCD is actively recruiting for a permanent Chancellor ("Chancellor Recruitment - 2026" posting on yosemite.edu), and the identity/dates of the prior permanent chancellor she succeeded could not be confirmed this session.

records.name: Ronald P. Gerhard
records.priorTitle: Vice Chancellor for Business Services / Vice President for Administrative Services, Chabot College
records.notes: Confirmed as current Chancellor via the district's own Chancellor's Office page. Prior to the chancellorship he served as Vice Chancellor for Business Services and VP for Administrative Services at Chabot College, and earlier held roles at City College of San Francisco, Peralta CCD, Compton CCD, and San Bernardino CCD (2001-2010). Over 20 years of experience in California community college administration. Exact start year as chancellor and predecessor's identity could not be confirmed this session.

records.name: Diana Z. Rodriguez
records.notes: The 16th Chancellor of SBCCD, appointed by the Board of Trustees in 2021; previously President of San Bernardino Valley College (2016-2021) and earlier VP of Student Services at Las Positas College and Palo Verde College. SBCCD's own site and Wikipedia do not name the 15th Chancellor (her immediate predecessor); that gap could not be closed this session.

records.name: Beatriz Chaidez
records.priorTitle: Interim Chancellor / Vice Chancellor of Human Resources / Associate Vice Chancellor of Human Resources
records.notes: Confirmed as current Chancellor via SJECCD's own site. Joined SJECCD in early 2019, rising through Associate VC and VC of Human Resources roles, then Interim Chancellor, before becoming permanent Chancellor (exact conversion year not specified on the page). Her predecessor was Byron D. Clift Breland, described elsewhere (NOCCCD's bio of Breland) as SJECCD's first African-American Chancellor who served roughly four years before departing to become Chancellor of North Orange County CCD (~2019); exact SJECCD tenure dates for Breland could not be independently confirmed this session.

records.name: Rosie Rimando-Chareunsap
records.notes: Per Seattle Colleges' own "Past Chancellors" page: served as Interim Chancellor 2022-2023, then named permanent Chancellor, with the district announcing her appointment on August 2, 2023.

records.name: Shouan Pan
records.notes: Per Seattle Colleges' official past-chancellors list. Left Seattle Colleges and later became Chancellor of Yuba Community College District in California.

records.name: Jill Wakefield
records.notes: Per Seattle Colleges' official past-chancellors list; the district's first female chancellor.

records.name: Charles Mitchell
records.notes: Per Seattle Colleges' official past-chancellors list.
